about.title: About Rice Brothers
text: The Rice Brothers have decades of proven experience providing the best in quality services and highly skilled crews to fit our clients project specific needs. Our projects are staffed with experienced managers, trained supervision, certified safety personnel and qualified skilled labor. Rice-Brothers ability to self-perform all major craft disciplines provides customers with a single source solution to our clients engineering, EPC, construction, maintenance, and electrical and instrumentation needs.
Decades of experience don’t come without a passion for the industry. We know the EPC business inside and out and we love working with our customers to bring jobs and manufacturing to life.
It’s all in the name. We are a team of brothers and we treat all of our employees and our clients as family. Reach out to us and see how we can work together.
